description: Attach a custom domain. For site domains, enables apex+www. Default primary=www. Required DNS: CNAME www → fallback.novence.ai. Then do exactly one apex option: ALIAS/ANAME/CNAME-flattening @ → fallback.novence.ai, or registrar URL-redirect @ → https://www.{domain}/. Pass primary=apex only when the apex must serve (ALIAS required; URL-redirect would loop). If the result has instructions.autoConfigure, the domain's DNS provider (e.g. Cloudflare) supports one-click setup: give the human autoConfigure.url to sign in and approve, instead of walking them through the records; then poll get_domain_status until live is true. A human must approve it; do not try to complete the provider's sign-in yourself. If you already have access to the user's DNS (e.g. Cloudflare tools), you may create instructions.records yourself instead.

primary.description: Which host is canonical. Default www.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

redirect.description: If true, redirect the non-primary host to the primary. Default true.
